name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations (global default)
description: Sets the global default so games run in true exclusive fullscreen instead of the FSO borderless path. This can reduce latency in some titles and hurt others (FSO helps alt-tab and some overlays), so it is opt-in and per-game results vary.
warning: Fullscreen Optimizations help some games (faster alt-tab, working overlays) and hurt others. Test your games and revert if any misbehave.
